channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A microeconomia de Lula
item.description: In a Globo interview, President Lula emphasized that economic growth hinges on microeconomics, criticizing wealth concentration and advocating for money circulation among the population. He warned that inequality will persist if assets remain concentrated in the hands of a few.

item.title: Saiba quem é o empresário Amauri Pinha, citado por Luschsinger
item.description: Amauri Pinha, president of ECB's Board of Directors (part of Mota-Engil Group), was cited by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger as close to Fábio Lula, son of the president, raising questions about R$2 billion contracts between the company and the federal government.

item.title: Meta tem de zelar por equilíbrio na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ordered Meta to maintain balance in political content distribution during the 2026 elections, following Lula's campaign complaint about preferential treatment for Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling aims to ensure fair play and prevent algorithmic manipulation through tools like Meta AI. Although no deliberate intent was found, the court emphasized its oversight role in electoral processes.

item.title: Vox Brasil: com empate técnico, Lula tem 46,4% e Flávio Bolsonaro 44,6%
item.description: The Vox Brasil/Arte/Metrópoles poll shows a technical tie between Lula (46.4%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (44.6%) in the 2026 presidential runoff, with a 2.15 percentage point margin of error. The survey, conducted from October 15 to 17, interviewed 2,100 people and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula tem 51% contra 49% de Flávio em votos válidos, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Lula leading with 51% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 49% in valid votes, within the margin of error. Both candidates have high rejection rates at 45.3%. The survey was conducted from October 15-17 with 2,100 voters and a margin of error of 2.15 points.

item.title: Lula tem 51% dos votos válidos, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 49%, diz pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: A survey by Instituto Vox Brasil shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 51% of valid votes against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 49% for the presidential runoff, a margin within the margin of error. The poll also reflects a slight improvement in the approval rating of President Lula and greater public expectation of his victory in the race.

item.title: Confira o que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula levaram para a propaganda eleitoral no rádio neste 2º turno
item.description: According to a g1 analysis, the second-round campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro focused on mutual attacks and themes such as 'change' and 'end of the 6-to-1 score'. Lula emphasized fears of the Bolsonaro family returning to power, while Flávio highlighted the transformation discourse. The radio ads were registered with the TSE between October 8 and 15.

item.title: No Instagram, Lula muda o discurso no segundo turno, e Flávio Bolsonaro mantém foco em voto e confronto
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro use Instagram differently in the runoff, with the president increasing mentions of his rival and the senator keeping voting and confrontation messages. The analysis of 2,129 posts shows a role reversal since pre-campaign.

item.title: Alcolumbre conta votos e traça planos para seguir no comando do Senado em governo de Lula ou de Flávio
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre intensified his campaign for re-election to the Senate presidency in 2027, despite opposition from the PL and the launch of Rogério Marinho as a candidate. The race escalated after Alcolumbre removed the Public Security Amendment Bill from the agenda, triggering an exchange of accusations with Marinho. Alcolumbre’s strategy focuses on splitting PL votes, leveraging alliances with senators like Eduardo Gomes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é o filho do Riocentro
item.description: The text links Flávio Bolsonaro's birth to the 1981 Riocentro bombing and highlights his history of defending the military dictatorship, including praise for repression figures and criticism of the Truth Commission. It also recalls his own and his father Jair Bolsonaro's statements about honoring the military and denying the 1964 coup.

item.title: Entrevista de Luchsinger vira meme após críticas a Lula
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (son of President Lula), harshly criticized the PT politician in an interview with CNN Brazil, accusing him of corruption and promising to sign a plea bargain. Her statements became memes on social media, especially among Lula's opponents. The Presidential Palace stated that President Lula does not know the facts and has no contract with the lobbyist, highlighting the timing near the second-round election. The allegations were described as an attempt to interfere with the democratic process.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem mobilização nas redes com camisa da Seleção
item.description: Lula supporters mobilized on social media using the Brazilian national team jersey and green and yellow colors, claiming national symbols for all Brazilians. The action, organized by federal deputy André Janones through the 'Exército do Lula', took place during the final stretch of the election campaign against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lulinha é covarde como o pai, diz Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Lobista Roberta Luchsinger called Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) 'cowardly like his father' after his silence regarding criticism from President Lula, with whom she is under investigation for alleged influence peddling. She demanded public defense and support from allies, citing isolation after asset freezes. The Presidency denied any relationship with her and questioned the timing of the accusations.

item.title: “Por que não foram na casa do filho do presidente?”, pergunta lobista
item.description: Lobist Roberta Luchsinger questioned the handling of the INSS investigation and criticized the absence of searches at the residence of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, suggesting unequal treatment based on machismo. She stated she will not spare anyone in a plea bargain, including the president and his son. The Presidency claimed Lula is unaware of the facts and that this is an attempt to influence the election.

item.title: A escala 5x2 é eleitoreira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and other analysts labeled Jair Bolsonaro's 5x2 scale as an electoral strategy, arguing that extreme positions that alienate allies risk popular rejection. The text compares this dynamic to Abraham Lincoln's 1864 re-election, suggesting that governments serving minority interests may face electoral backlash.

item.title: Os debates decidirão a parada
item.description: The debates scheduled for October 17 and 23, 2026 on Band and Globo are crucial to decide the presidential race. Lula is already known as either approved or rejected, while Flávio Bolsonaro carries the legacy of his surname and anti-petism. The ideological divide has persisted for 18 years, with similar proposals from both sides.

item.title: Lula volta a dizer que nunca teve interlocução com Luchsinger
item.description: President Lula reiterated that he never had contact with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, denying the claims she made in an interview with CNN Brasil, particularly one published ahead of the runoff election. His office stated there is no government contract with the lobbyist and questioned the timing of the allegations. Luchsinger is under investigation for influence peddling alongside Lula's son, Fábio Luís.

item.title: São Paulo protesta contra MP das Bets com mensagem em camisa
item.description: São Paulo took the field wearing shirts protesting against the Bets MP, which banned betting houses, with the slogan 'prohibiting is not protecting'. Various entities and clubs have asked the Supreme Court to suspend the measure, arguing that the ban encourages illegal betting and harms Brazilian football.

item.title: Flávio comemora entrevista de lobista e deputada do PL quer proteção para testemunha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated statements by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his son, calling them liars and lacking character. PL leaders requested protection for Luchsinger amid threats, while PT supporters avoided direct reactions on social media.

item.title: Flávio realiza ato na Bahia e recebe título de Cidadão de Salvador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a campaign event in Bahia and received the title of Citizen of Salvador following a ceremony at Farol da Barra. The event, initially suspended by a judicial decision, had its injunction overturned by TJ-BA. During his speech, the candidate criticized the current government and promised to make the poor rich, parading along the Salvador waterfront with supporters and political allies.

item.title: Lobista diz que Lulinha se reunia com ministros e afirma querer fazer delação premiada
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger responded to President Lula's criticism, where he called her a 'scammer', and reported receiving threats. She and Lula's son, Lulinha, are under investigation at the Supreme Court for alleged influence peddling. Luchsinger sought protection and highlighted the different treatment by Lula toward her and her son.

item.title: Lula mente e não pode continuar na Presidência, diz Luchsinger
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger told CNN Brasil that President Lula lies constantly and cannot remain in office, after being called a 'swindler' by the PT leader. She noted her previous support for Lula but said it hurts to criticize him due to an influence peddling investigation involving his son. The Secretariat of Social Communication denied any government relationship with the lobbyist and questioned the timing of the accusations near the runoff.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula realizam atos em diversas cidades e capitais
item.description: Supporters of Lula held demonstrations in various cities and capitals across the country on Saturday, including Florianópolis, Goiânia, João Pessoa, and Curitiba. The movements featured women's groups organizing pro-reelection rallies with cultural performances and tributes to victims of femicide. President Lula, a PT candidate in the runoff, had no public campaign schedule on Saturday.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz campanha em Vitória e Salvador; apoiadores realizam atos e carreatas em capitais brasileiras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held campaign events in Vitória (ES) and Salvador (BA), emphasizing public security proposals and pledging to combat criminal organizations. Supporters carried out caravans in Florianópolis, Curitiba, and Brasília, reinforcing campaign mobilization.

item.title: Campanhas de Lula e Flávio querem explorar contradições e contraste de perfis em debate Band/Estadão
item.description: Lula and Flávio are gearing up for a Band/Estadão debate, each ready to highlight the other's contradictions. Lula may press Flávio on the 6x1 tax scale, while Flávio will question Lula over Roberta Luchsinger's interview. Both aim to sway undecided voters amid ongoing parallel investigations.

item.title: Ministério da Justiça aciona MP e ANPD contra a Meta por falhas que afetaram campanha de Lula
item.description: The Ministry of Justice filed lawsuits against Meta with federal prosecutors and Brazil's data protection agency over Instagram failures that harmed Lula's campaign. The company admitted technical flaws but denied political intent. The government called for audits and found similar issues involving Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Coligação de Lula aciona PF e PGE para investigar possível benefício ilegal da Meta à campanha de Flávio
item.description: Lula's coalition filed a lawsuit with the Federal Police and the Electoral Public Ministry to investigate whether Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign received undeclared benefits from Meta, including alleged disparities in video reach and AI usage. The coalition estimates the excess views may amount to R$ 7.4 million in paid promotion and requests interviews with campaign officials and Meta representatives. Meta denied election interference but acknowledged technical issues that have been fixed.

item.title: Flávio percorre orla de Salvador entre gritos de 'volta, Bolsonaro' e provocações de petistas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro walked along the boardwalk in Salvador with support for Jair Bolsonaro, facing provocations from PT supporters during his movement.

item.title: Lobista amiga de Lulinha chama Lula de 'canalha' e diz que fará delação
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, under investigation for ties to Fábio Luis Lula da Silva and suspected business irregularities, called Lula 'scum' and announced plans to cooperate in exchange for a plea deal after being labeled 'rascal' by the president.

item.title: Veja onde assistir São Paulo x Vasco ao vivo neste sábado (17)
item.description: São Paulo and Vasco face off this Saturday at 21:00 (Brasília time) at the Morumbis stadium, in the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. The match is part of the tournament's single-phase schedule.

item.title: Flávio faz apelo a eleitores "oprimidos" e reforça que o voto é secreto
item.description: At a rally in Salvador, senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) urged voters to cast their ballots without fear, emphasizing that the vote is secret. He pledged to combat militias and factions such as PCC and Comando Vermelho by designating them narco-terrorist organizations, and stated he will govern for all, including Lula supporters.

item.title: “Tem contrato de 2 bilhões com vizinho de Lulinha”, diz Luchsinger à CNN
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger told CNN that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, frequently met with the head of Mota-Engil, the company awarded a BRL 2.6 billion contract for the Santos-Guarujá tunnel. She also threatened to become a protected witness and claimed to be under threats, holding Lula responsible for any harm that may befall her.

item.title: “Eles são cúmplices”, diz Luchsinger sobre Lula e Lulinha
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger accused President Lula of lying when he claimed not to know his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva's (Lulinha) activities, alleging that the socialist uses public funds to attack her image. She also reported threats and demanded that Lula report any suspicions of misconduct involving close relatives to the police.

item.title: Lula denuncia a Flávio Bolsonaro ante la policía de Brasil y la ONU por las supuestas ventajas de Meta en la campaña
item.description: Lula denounces Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged preferential treatment by Meta during the campaign, requesting investigations by the UN, Public Ministry, and Federal Police for illegal funding. The social media battle escalates before the October 25th elections, with polls showing a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Luchsinger afirma que fará delação: “Não serei eu o boi de piranha”
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger announced plans to sign a plea bargain, denying being a scapegoat while promising to investigate everyone, including President Lula and his son. She is under investigation by PF for influence peddling and has ties to Fábio Luís Lula da Silva.

item.title: "Por que não foram na casa do filho do presidente?", diz Luchsinger
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger accused President Lula of protecting his son Fábio Luís in influence trafficking investigations and threatened to file a plea deal. She also suggested that Fábio acted for Mota-Engil through Amaury Pinha, a neighbor of Lulinha, and challenged Lula to investigate his own family. Luchsinger has been repeatedly called a 'thug' by Lula.

item.title: Lulinha esteve com ministros e Lula mentiu, diz Luchsinger
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger told CNN Brasil that she has repeatedly seen President Lula’s son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), meeting with government ministers, including Camilo Santana, Alexandre Padilha, and Frederico de Siqueira Filho. She accused Lula of lying when denying his son’s connections, while under investigation for alleged influence peddling. These meetings allegedly took place regularly in Brasília and at former ministers’ residences.

item.title: Vou fazer delação premiada, diz lobista Roberta Luchsinger sócia de Lulinha
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger announced in an interview with CNN that she intends to sign a plea bargain to disclose information about her former partner, Fábio Luís Lula Silva, the son of President Lula. She stated she would not spare anyone, including a president's son, and justified the plea bargain by claiming a perceived political persecution against her and her daughters.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha diz à CNN que Lula mentiu e que filho de presidente se reuniu com ministros
item.description: Roberta Luschinger, a close friend of Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, accused President Lula of lying about his son’s alleged meetings with ministers, claiming the encounter was to discuss the release of cannabidiol through the Ministry of Health. She justified her statements due to public remarks by the president and received threats.

item.title: Luchsinger diz que Lula teve atitude canalha ao chamá-la de pilantra
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger labeled President Lula's August remark calling her 'pilantra' on live TV as 'cowardly' and 'unscrupulous.' She claimed to receive around 50 death threats daily and that her daughters’ social media accounts were flooded with rape and stabbing threats. Under investigation for alleged influence peddling with Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, she accused Lula of using public broadcast to attack her.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido do Novo para barrar atos com artistas em apoio a Lula
item.description: The Chief Electoral Court Clerk, Justice Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, rejected the Brazilian Social Democracy Party's request to suspend the Brazil in the Streets demonstrations, ruling there is no evidence the events constitute rallies or electoral meetings organized by artists in support of Lula. The minister clarified that while the law prohibits musical performances at political rallies, artists may publicly express political preferences. The ruling emphasizes that political alignment between organizers and a candidate does not imply an organizational or financial link between civil society movements and campaigns.

item.title: “Lula é mentiroso e age com canalhice”, diz amiga de Lulinha
item.description: Businesswoman and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger called President Lula a liar and accused him of acting with bad faith and scoundrel behavior after being labeled a scammer. In an interview with CNN Brasil, she claimed that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, met several times with government ministers. The statement sparked controversy regarding relationships between entrepreneurs and federal government members.

item.title: Lobista diz que Lulinha reuniu-se inúmeras vezes com ministros e quer fazer delação sem poupar Lula
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger offered a plea bargain and accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his son Lulinha of influence peddling, denying Lula offered her a government position. Investigations examine alleged irregularities in client hiring and access to the Planalto Palace, with three inquiries at the Supreme Court.

item.title: O que diz a centro-direta em manifesto pró-Lula: "Ameaças e retrocesso"
item.description: A group of centrist-right politicians and personalities, including former ministers, signed a manifesto supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) reelection, highlighting risks to the Democratic State of Law, social achievements, and international engagement if Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) becomes president. Despite criticisms of Lula's administration, the document emphasizes the need to preserve rights, freedoms, and dialogue channels to prevent institutional setbacks.

item.title: Ministro do TSE nega pedido para impedir atos de artistas apoiadores de Lula
item.description: The Chief Clerk of the Electoral Court, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, rejected Novo Party's request to suspend artistic pro-democracy events, stating there is insufficient evidence linking them to Lula's official campaign. He emphasized that banning them would constitute prior censorship, but warned that any illegal activities during the events could face legal consequences.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pode não ser chanceler, mas vem aí ‘faxina’ no Itamaraty e nas Forças Armadas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro ruled out appointing his brother Eduardo as chancellor, but fears persist regarding a purge at Itamaraty and the Armed Forces, mimicking authoritarian practices. Diplomats and military worry about political persecution and institutional destabilization.

item.title: Perícia confirma voz de Vorcaro em áudios sobre filme de Lula
item.description: An acoustic analysis confirmed that the audio recordings attributed to Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, match his voice. The recordings allegedly discuss payments related to the production of a documentary about Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the Lula Institute. The revelation was published by Veja magazine on Saturday night, the 17th.

item.title: Depois de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro diz ser prejudicado pela Meta e pede para TSE proibir impulsionamento de posts negativos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) filed a lawsuit with the TSE demanding that Meta be barred from allowing paid promotion of negative posts during the second-round election, claiming his candidacy has been harmed by irregularly distributed negative ads. He seeks to join the case also filed by Lula against Meta and urges measures to suspend paid negative or false content within 24 hours.

item.title: Nunes Marques derruba vídeo de Lula que afirma que Flávio ‘recebeu’ dinheiro de Vorcaro
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques ordered the removal of a Lula video alleging Flávio Bolsonaro received R$70 million from Vorcaro. The decision is provisional and will be reviewed by the TSE plenary.

item.title: Lula quer “desmascarar mentiras” de Flávio no debate, diz Edinho
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, stated that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva intends to directly confront Flávio Bolsonaro in the upcoming Band debate, aiming to expose lies and reveal to voters what the PL candidate represents. The debate is expected to be a direct clash between the presidential candidates.
